<span class="hljs-tag"><<span class="hljs-name">script</span>></span><span class="language-javascript">
  <span class="hljs-comment">// Alternate login: UAE PASS is the default view. The quiet "Use other login option"</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// button swaps the panel to the username and password fallback, and "Back to UAE PASS"</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// swaps it back. Focus moves to each view's heading so screen readers hear the change.</span>
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-login]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">login</span>) =></span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> views = login.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-login-view]'</span>);

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">show</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">name</span>) => {
      views.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">view</span>) =></span> { view.<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span> = view.<span class="hljs-property">dataset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">loginView</span> !== name; });
      login.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`[data-login-view="<span class="hljs-subst">${name}</span>"] h2`</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">focus</span>();
    };

    login.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-login-show]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">trigger</span>) =></span> {
      trigger.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> <span class="hljs-title function_">show</span>(trigger.<span class="hljs-property">dataset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">loginShow</span>));
    });

    <span class="hljs-comment">// Fallback form: show each field's error under it, and on a failed submit</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">// move focus to the first problem (the design system's whole-form pattern).</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> form = login.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-login-form]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> fields = [...form.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'aegov-input'</span>)];

    <span class="hljs-comment">// When the warning is dismissed its close button disappears, so move focus</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">// to the first field instead of letting it fall back to the page.</span>
    login.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'aegovCalloutDismiss'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> fields[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>].<span class="hljs-title function_">focus</span>());

    form.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'aegovValidate'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">event</span>) =></span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (event.<span class="hljs-property">detail</span>.<span class="hljs-property">trigger</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'input'</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> valid = event.<span class="hljs-property">detail</span>.<span class="hljs-property">validity</span>.<span class="hljs-property">valid</span>;
      event.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>.<span class="hljs-property">isInvalid</span> = !valid;
      event.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>.<span class="hljs-property">errorMessage</span> = valid ? <span class="hljs-string">''</span> : event.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>.<span class="hljs-property">dataset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">requiredMessage</span>;
    });

    form.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'submit'</span>, <span class="hljs-title function_">async</span> (event) => {
      event.<span class="hljs-title function_">preventDefault</span>();
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> results = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">all</span>(fields.<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">field</span>) =></span> field.<span class="hljs-title function_">validate</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'submit'</span>)));
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> firstInvalid = fields.<span class="hljs-title function_">find</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">_, index</span>) =></span> !results[index].<span class="hljs-property">valid</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (firstInvalid) {

        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
      }
      <span class="hljs-comment">// Example only: send new FormData(form) to your sign-in endpoint here.</span>

<span class="hljs-tag"><<span class="hljs-name">script</span>></span><span class="language-javascript">
  <span class="hljs-comment">// OTP step: the resend link stays off for 30 seconds, then turns on and says so</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// through a polite status message (the countdown itself is not announced every second).</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// Submit checks the code is complete and moves focus back to the cells if it is not.</span>
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-otp]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">block</span>) =></span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">WAIT_SECONDS</span> = <span class="hljs-number">30</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> form = block.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-otp-form]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> otp = form.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'aegov-otp'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> resend = block.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-otp-resend]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> status = block.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-otp-status]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> timer;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">format</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">seconds</span>) => <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">floor</span>(seconds / <span class="hljs-number">60</span>) + <span class="hljs-string">':'</span> + <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(seconds % <span class="hljs-number">60</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">padStart</span>(<span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'0'</span>);

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">startCooldown</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) => {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> remaining = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">WAIT_SECONDS</span>;
      resend.<span class="hljs-property">disabled</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>;
      resend.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'Resend code in '</span> + <span class="hljs-title function_">format</span>(remaining);
      <span class="hljs-built_in">clearInterval</span>(timer);
      timer = <span class="hljs-built_in">setInterval</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =></span> {
        remaining -= <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (remaining > <span class="hljs-number">0</span>) {
          resend.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'Resend code in '</span> + <span class="hljs-title function_">format</span>(remaining);
          <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
        }
        <span class="hljs-built_in">clearInterval</span>(timer);
        resend.<span class="hljs-property">disabled</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;
        resend.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'Resend code'</span>;
        status.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'You can now request a new code.'</span>;
      }, <span class="hljs-number">1000</span>);
    };

    resend.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// Example only: ask your service to send a new code here.</span>
      otp.<span class="hljs-title function_">clear</span>();
      otp.<span class="hljs-property">isInvalid</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;
      otp.<span class="hljs-property">errorMessage</span> = <span class="hljs-string">''</span>;
      status.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = <span class="hljs-string">"We've sent a new code to your mobile number."</span>;
      <span class="hljs-title function_">startCooldown</span>();
      otp.<span class="hljs-title function_">focus</span>();
    });

    form.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'aegovValidate'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">event</span>) =></span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (event.<span class="hljs-property">detail</span>.<span class="hljs-property">trigger</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'input'</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> valid = event.<span class="hljs-property">detail</span>.<span class="hljs-property">validity</span>.<span class="hljs-property">valid</span>;
      otp.<span class="hljs-property">isInvalid</span> = !valid;
      otp.<span class="hljs-property">errorMessage</span> = valid ? <span class="hljs-string">''</span> : <span class="hljs-string">'Enter the 6-digit code from your text message'</span>;
    });

    form.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'submit'</span>, <span class="hljs-title function_">async</span> (event) => {
      event.<span class="hljs-title function_">preventDefault</span>();
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> result = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> otp.<span class="hljs-title function_">validate</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'submit'</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!result.<span class="hljs-property">valid</span>) {
        otp.<span class="hljs-title function_">focus</span>();
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
      }
      <span class="hljs-comment">// Example only: send new FormData(form) to your verification endpoint here.</span>
    });

    <span class="hljs-title function_">startCooldown</span>();
  });
</span><span class="hljs-tag"></<span class="hljs-name">script</span>></span></code></pre>

<span class="hljs-tag"><<span class="hljs-name">script</span>></span><span class="language-javascript">
  <span class="hljs-comment">// Stacked reminder deck: Previous / Next rotate the cards. Only the top card is</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// exposed to assistive technology; each change is announced politely.</span>
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-deck]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">deck</span>) =></span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> cards = <span class="hljs-title class_">Array</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">from</span>(deck.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-deck-card]'</span>));
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> count = deck.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-deck-count]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> live = deck.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-deck-live]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> current = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">render</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) => {
      cards.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">card, index</span>) =></span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> position = (index - current + cards.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>) % cards.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>;
        card.<span class="hljs-property">dataset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">pos</span> = <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(position, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>));
        card.<span class="hljs-property">inert</span> = position !== <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
        card.<span class="hljs-title function_">setAttribute</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'aria-hidden'</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(position !== <span class="hljs-number">0</span>));
      });
      count.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${current + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>}</span> / <span class="hljs-subst">${cards.length}</span>`</span>;
    };

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">move</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">step</span>) => {
      current = (current + step + cards.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>) % cards.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>;
      <span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>();
      live.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = <span class="hljs-string">`Reminder <span class="hljs-subst">${current + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>}</span> of <span class="hljs-subst">${cards.length}</span>: <span class="hljs-subst">${cards[current].querySelector(<span class="hljs-string">'h3'</span>).textContent}</span>`</span>;
    };

    deck.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-deck-prev]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> <span class="hljs-title function_">move</span>(-<span class="hljs-number">1</span>));
    deck.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-deck-next]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> <span class="hljs-title function_">move</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>));
    <span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>();
  });
</span><span class="hljs-tag"></<span class="hljs-name">script</span>></span></code></pre>

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> live = tour.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-tour-live]'</span>);

    buttons.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">button</span>) =></span> {
      button.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> target = button.<span class="hljs-property">dataset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tourBtn</span>;
        buttons.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">other</span>) =></span> other.<span class="hljs-title function_">setAttribute</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'aria-pressed'</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(other === button)));
        spots.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">spot</span>) =></span> { spot.<span class="hljs-property">dataset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">on</span> = <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(spot.<span class="hljs-property">dataset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tourSpot</span> === target); });

      });
    });

<span class="hljs-tag"><<span class="hljs-name">script</span>></span><span class="language-javascript">
  <span class="hljs-comment">// Rising towers: grow the towers and count the figures up once, when the chart</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// scrolls into view. The final values are already in the HTML, so people using</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// reduced motion (or no JavaScript) see them straight away, and screen readers</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// read the sr-only text, never the moving numbers.</span>
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-towers]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">chart</span>) =></span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> towers = [...chart.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-tower]'</span>)];
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> reduceMotion = <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">matchMedia</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)'</span>).<span class="hljs-property">matches</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (reduceMotion || !(<span class="hljs-string">'IntersectionObserver'</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>)) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">DURATION</span> = <span class="hljs-number">700</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">STAGGER</span> = <span class="hljs-number">60</span>;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">draw</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">tower, value</span>) => {
      tower.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> = value + <span class="hljs-string">'%'</span>;
      tower.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-count]'</span>).<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">round</span>(value) + <span class="hljs-string">'%'</span>;
    };

    towers.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">tower</span>) =></span> <span class="hljs-title function_">draw</span>(tower, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>));

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">run</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) => {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> startedAt = performance.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>();
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">frame</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">now</span>) => {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> running = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;
        towers.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">tower, index</span>) =></span> {
          <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> progress = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">max</span>((now - startedAt - index * <span class="hljs-variable constant_">STAGGER</span>) / <span class="hljs-variable constant_">DURATION</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>), <span class="hljs-number">1</span>);
          <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> eased = <span class="hljs-number">1</span> - <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">pow</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span> - progress, <span class="hljs-number">3</span>);
          <span class="hljs-title function_">draw</span>(tower, <span class="hljs-title class_">Number</span>(tower.<span class="hljs-property">dataset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tower</span>) * eased);
          <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (progress < <span class="hljs-number">1</span>) running = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>;
        });
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (running) <span class="hljs-title function_">requestAnimationFrame</span>(frame);
      };
      <span class="hljs-title function_">requestAnimationFrame</span>(frame);
    };

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> observer = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">IntersectionObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">entries</span>) =></span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (entries.<span class="hljs-title function_">some</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">entry</span>) =></span> entry.<span class="hljs-property">isIntersecting</span>)) {
        observer.<span class="hljs-title function_">disconnect</span>();
        <span class="hljs-title function_">run</span>();
      }
    }, { <span class="hljs-attr">threshold</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.4</span> });
    observer.<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>(chart);
  });
</span><span class="hljs-tag"></<span class="hljs-name">script</span>></span></code></pre>

<span class="hljs-tag"><<span class="hljs-name">script</span>></span><span class="language-javascript">
  <span class="hljs-comment">// A day in numbers: the range slider (or a click on a bar) picks an hour.</span>

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> busiest = values.<span class="hljs-title function_">indexOf</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">max</span>(...values));
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> number = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Intl</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">NumberFormat</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'en'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">pad</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">hour</span>) => <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(hour % <span class="hljs-number">24</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">padStart</span>(<span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'0'</span>) + <span class="hljs-string">':00'</span>;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> time = day.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-day-time]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> count = day.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-day-count]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> share = day.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-day-share]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> note = day.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-day-note]'</span>);

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">select</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">hour</span>) => {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> value = values[hour];
      bars.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">bar, index</span>) =></span> bar.<span class="hljs-title function_">toggleAttribute</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'data-on'</span>, index === hour));
      time.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">pad</span>(hour) + <span class="hljs-string">' – '</span> + <span class="hljs-title function_">pad</span>(hour + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>);
      count.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = number.<span class="hljs-title function_">format</span>(value);

      range.<span class="hljs-title function_">setAttribute</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'aria-valuetext'</span>, <span class="hljs-title function_">pad</span>(hour) + <span class="hljs-string">' to '</span> + <span class="hljs-title function_">pad</span>(hour + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>) + <span class="hljs-string">': '</span> + number.<span class="hljs-title function_">format</span>(value) + <span class="hljs-string">' requests'</span>);

<span class="hljs-tag"><<span class="hljs-name">script</span>></span><span class="language-javascript">

<span class="hljs-tag"><<span class="hljs-name">script</span>></span><span class="language-javascript">
  <span class="hljs-comment">// Help and support drawer. The search filters the articles as you type and says</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// when nothing matches; the footer asks whether the help was useful and thanks</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// the person. The drawer floats with a gap on larger screens and is pinned on phones.</span>
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-help-open]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">trigger</span>) =></span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> drawer = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getElementById</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'help-drawer'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> help = drawer.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-help]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> search = help.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-help-search]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> articles = [...help.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-help-articles] > li'</span>)];
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> list = help.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-help-articles]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> empty = help.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-help-empty]'</span>);

    search.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'aegovInputValue'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> query = (search.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> || <span class="hljs-string">''</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">trim</span>().<span class="hljs-title function_">toLowerCase</span>();
      <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> shown = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
      articles.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">article</span>) =></span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> match = article.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">toLowerCase</span>().<span class="hljs-title function_">includes</span>(query);
        article.<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span> = !match;
        shown += match ? <span class="hljs-number">1</span> : <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
      });
      list.<span class="hljs-property">classList</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">toggle</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'hidden'</span>, shown === <span class="hljs-number">0</span>);
      empty.<span class="hljs-property">classList</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">toggle</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'hidden'</span>, shown > <span class="hljs-number">0</span>);
      empty.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = shown ? <span class="hljs-string">''</span> : <span class="hljs-string">`No articles match "<span class="hljs-subst">${search.value.trim()}</span>". Try another word, or talk to us below.`</span>;
    });

    help.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-help-vote]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">button</span>) =></span> {
      button.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> {
        <span class="hljs-comment">// Example only: send the vote to your feedback endpoint here.</span>
        help.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-help-feedback]'</span>).<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>;
        help.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-help-thanks]'</span>).<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = button.<span class="hljs-property">dataset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">helpVote</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'yes'</span>
          ? <span class="hljs-string">'Thanks for letting us know.'</span>
          : <span class="hljs-string">'Thanks. Tell us more by live chat or email, and we will improve this help.'</span>;
      });
    });

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> wide = <span class="hljs-title function_">matchMedia</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'(min-width: 640px)'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">pin</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) => drawer.<span class="hljs-title function_">setAttribute</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'is-pinned'</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(!wide.<span class="hljs-property">matches</span>));
    <span class="hljs-title function_">pin</span>();
    wide.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'change'</span>, pin);

    trigger.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> drawer.<span class="hljs-title function_">show</span>());
    help.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-help-close]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> drawer.<span class="hljs-title function_">close</span>());
  });
</span><span class="hljs-tag"></<span class="hljs-name">script</span>></span></code></pre>

<span class="hljs-tag"></<span class="hljs-name">aegov-drawer</span>></span>

<span class="hljs-tag"><<span class="hljs-name">script</span>></span><span class="language-javascript">
  <span class="hljs-comment">// Notifications centre. Unread items carry a dot and a "Mark as read" button;</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// using an item's action also marks it read. The filter shows all or only unread,</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// and the counts in the header, the filter and the page's bell stay in step.</span>
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-notes-open]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">trigger</span>) =></span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> drawer = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getElementById</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'notes-drawer'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> panel = drawer.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-notes]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> notes = [...panel.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-note]'</span>)];
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> status = panel.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-notes-status]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> dot = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-notes-dot]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> filter = <span class="hljs-string">'all'</span>;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">update</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) => {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> unread = notes.<span class="hljs-title function_">filter</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">note</span>) =></span> note.<span class="hljs-property">dataset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">unread</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'true'</span>).<span class="hljs-property">length</span>;
      panel.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-notes-summary]'</span>).<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = unread ? <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${unread}</span> unread`</span> : <span class="hljs-string">'All caught up'</span>;
      panel.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-notes-count]'</span>).<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = unread;
      panel.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-notes-all]'</span>).<span class="hljs-property">isDisabled</span> = !unread;
      dot.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = unread;
      dot.<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span> = !unread;
      trigger.<span class="hljs-title function_">setAttribute</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'aria-label'</span>, unread ? <span class="hljs-string">`Notifications, <span class="hljs-subst">${unread}</span> unread`</span> : <span class="hljs-string">'Notifications'</span>);
      notes.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">note</span>) =></span> { note.<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span> = filter === <span class="hljs-string">'unread'</span> && note.<span class="hljs-property">dataset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">unread</span> !== <span class="hljs-string">'true'</span>; });
      panel.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-notes-group]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">group</span>) =></span> {
        group.<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span> = !group.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-note]:not([hidden])'</span>);
      });
      panel.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-notes-empty]'</span>).<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span> = notes.<span class="hljs-title function_">some</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">note</span>) =></span> !note.<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span>);
    };

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">markRead</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">note</span>) => {
      note.<span class="hljs-property">dataset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">unread</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'false'</span>;
      note.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-note-flag]'</span>).<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = <span class="hljs-string">''</span>;
    };

    panel.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">event</span>) =></span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> note = event.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">closest</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-note]'</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (event.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">closest</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-note-read]'</span>)) {
        <span class="hljs-title function_">markRead</span>(note);
        <span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>();
        status.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'Marked as read'</span>;
        <span class="hljs-comment">// The button is gone now; keep focus on the item's text.</span>
        note.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'p'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">setAttribute</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'tabindex'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'-1'</span>);

      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (choice) {

        panel.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-notes-filter]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">button</span>) =></span> button.<span class="hljs-title function_">setAttribute</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'aria-pressed'</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(button === choice)));
        <span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>();
      }
    });

    panel.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-notes-all]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> {
      notes.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(markRead);
      <span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>();
      status.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'All notifications marked as read'</span>;
    });

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> wide = <span class="hljs-title function_">matchMedia</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'(min-width: 640px)'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">pin</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) => drawer.<span class="hljs-title function_">setAttribute</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'is-pinned'</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(!wide.<span class="hljs-property">matches</span>));
    <span class="hljs-title function_">pin</span>();
    wide.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'change'</span>, pin);

    trigger.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> drawer.<span class="hljs-title function_">show</span>());
    panel.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-notes-close]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> drawer.<span class="hljs-title function_">close</span>());
    <span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>();
  });
</span><span class="hljs-tag"></<span class="hljs-name">script</span>></span></code></pre>

<span class="hljs-tag"><<span class="hljs-name">script</span>></span><span class="language-javascript">
  <span class="hljs-comment">// Task modal: "Open task" opens it, the close button and the backdrop close it,</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// and focus returns to "Open task". Inside, comments can be posted (with an</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// optional attachment), reacted to and replied to.</span>
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-task-open]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">trigger</span>) =></span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> modal = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getElementById</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'task-modal'</span>);

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> status = task.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-task-status]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">announce</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">message</span>) => { status.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = <span class="hljs-string">''</span>; <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =></span> { status.<span class="hljs-property">textContent</span> = message; }, <span class="hljs-number">50</span>); };

    trigger.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> modal.<span class="hljs-title function_">show</span>());
    task.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-task-close]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> modal.<span class="hljs-title function_">close</span>());

    <span class="hljs-comment">// Copy link: an icon button from sm up, a menu item below it.</span>
    task.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-task-copy]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">copy</span>) =></span> copy.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-title function_">async</span> (event) => {
      event.<span class="hljs-title function_">preventDefault</span>();
      copy.<span class="hljs-title function_">closest</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'aegov-dropdown'</span>)?.<span class="hljs-title function_">closeDropdown</span>();
      <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> navigator.<span class="hljs-property">clipboard</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">writeText</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${location.origin}</span><span class="hljs-subst">${location.pathname}</span>#TSK-1042`</span>);
        <span class="hljs-title function_">announce</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Task link copied'</span>);
      } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> {
        <span class="hljs-title function_">announce</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'The link could not be copied'</span>);
      }
    }));

    <span class="hljs-comment">// Reactions: a toggle button whose count follows its pressed state.</span>
    task.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">event</span>) =></span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> reaction = event.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">closest</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-reaction]'</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!reaction) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> pressed = reaction.<span class="hljs-title function_">getAttribute</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'aria-pressed'</span>) === <span class="hljs-string">'true'</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> count = reaction.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-reaction-count]'</span>);
      reaction.<span class="hljs-title function_">setAttribute</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'aria-pressed'</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(!pressed));

<span class="hljs-tag"><<span class="hljs-name">script</span>></span><span class="language-javascript">
  <span class="hljs-comment">// Terms modal. The terms scroll on their own, with a progress bar and a fade that</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// shows there is more to read. "Accept and continue" stays disabled until the</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// checkbox is ticked; the status line beside it says why, and what changed.</span>
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-terms-open]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">trigger</span>) =></span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> modal = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getElementById</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'terms-modal'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> terms = modal.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-terms]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> scroller = terms.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-terms-scroll]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> progress = terms.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-terms-progress]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> fade = terms.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-terms-fade]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> agree = terms.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-terms-agree]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> accept = terms.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-terms-accept]'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> statusText = terms.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-terms-status-text]'</span>);

    trigger.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> modal.<span class="hljs-title function_">show</span>());
    terms.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-terms-close]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> modal.<span class="hljs-title function_">close</span>());
    terms.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'[data-terms-decline]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> modal.<span class="hljs-title function_">close</span>());
    accept.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// Example only: record the acceptance, then continue the application.</span>
      modal.<span class="hljs-title function_">close</span>();
    });

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">updateProgress</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) => {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> scrollable = scroller.<span class="hljs-property">scrollHeight</span> - scroller.<span class="hljs-property">clientHeight</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> read = scrollable > <span class="hljs-number">0</span> ? <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">round</span>((scroller.<span class="hljs-property">scrollTop</span> / scrollable) * <span class="hljs-number">100</span>) : <span class="hljs-number">100</span>;
      progress.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = read;
      fade.<span class="hljs-property">classList</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">toggle</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'opacity-0'</span>, read >= <span class="hljs-number">98</span>);
    };
    scroller.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'scroll'</span>, updateProgress, { <span class="hljs-attr">passive</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> });

    agree.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'aegovCheckboxChange'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =></span> {

      accept.<span class="hljs-property">isDisabled</span> = !agreed;

                <h1 class="text-h3 lg:text-h2 xl:text-h1 mb-4 text-primary-700">Aspect Ratio</h1>
                <p class="text-base lg:text-lg leading-normal text-aeblack-600">An Aspect Ratio component enforces a specific width-to-height ratio on its slotted content. Use it to wrap images, videos, and iframes that should hold a consistent shape regardless of viewport size — preventing layout shift as media loads.                     <div class="prose max-w-none prose-headings:tracking-tight prose-headings:text-aeblack-800 prose-a:text-primary-700 prose-h1:text-h3 lg:prose-h1:text-h2 xl:prose-h1:text-h1 prose-h2:text-h4 lg:prose-h2:text-h3 xl:prose-h2:text-h2 prose-h3:text-h5 lg:prose-h3:text-h4 xl:prose-h3:text-h3 prose-h4:text-h6 lg:prose-h4:text-h5 xl:prose-h4:text-h4 prose-h5:text-lg lg:prose-h5:text-h6 xl:prose-h5:text-h5 prose-h6:text-base lg:prose-h6:text-lg xl:prose-h6:text-h6">
    <p>The following notes are applicable of this component.</p>
<h3 id="built-in-accessibility">Built-in accessibility</h3>
<ul>
<li>The component introduces no roles, landmarks, or ARIA attributes of its own — it is purely a layout primitive. Slotted content (<code>img</code>, <code>iframe</code>, <code>video</code>) retains its native semantics.</li>
<li>Invalid <code>ratio</code> strings silently fall back to <code>auto</code>; invalid <code>fit</code> values fall back to <code>cover</code> and log a console warning during development.</li>
<li>The inner container uses <code>overflow: clip</code> with a 4px <code>overflow-clip-margin</code> instead of <code>overflow: hidden</code>. Focus rings on slotted interactive elements remain visible up to 4px outside the clipping boundary, satisfying WCAG SC 2.4.11 (Focus Not Obscured). Unlike <code>overflow: hidden</code>, <code>overflow: clip</code> does not create a new scroll container or stacking context.</li>
<li>On load, the component checks every slotted <code><iframe></code> for a <code>title</code> attribute and logs a <code>console.warn</code> if one is missing — surfacing the WCAG SC 4.1.2 requirement during development without breaking the page.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="developer-responsibility">Developer responsibility</h3>
<p>The following is required for a developer to add additionally or pay attention to regarding this component.</p>
<ul>
<li>Provide meaningful <code>alt</code> text on slotted <code><img></code> elements. For purely decorative imagery, use <code>alt=""</code> so screen readers skip it.</li>
<li>Provide a <code>title</code> attribute on every embedded <code><iframe></code> (maps, video players) so assistive technology can announce the embed. The component only warns about a missing title in the console — it does not add one for you.</li>
<li>Provide accessible captions or a transcript for <code><video></code> content where required.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="additional-notes">Additional notes</h3>
<ul>
<li>Controls that need a focus ring wider than 4px (the <code>overflow-clip-margin</code> value) should increase their own <code>outline-offset</code> accordingly, since content further than 4px outside the box is still clipped.</li>
</ul>

</div>

    <h2 id="anatomy">Anatomy</h2>
<p>The <code>aegov-badge</code> component renders a single inline <code><span></code> element containing the slotted label. An optional leading icon can be slotted before the text, and an optional trailing dismiss button is rendered when <code>is-dismissible</code> is set.</p>
<p><img src="https://designsystem.gov.ae/storage/documentation/badge/badge-anatomoy-img-001.png" alt="Image showing anatomy of a badge"></p>

</tr>

<td><strong>Icon</strong> <em>(optional)</em></td>
<td>An inline SVG or image slotted before the label to reinforce meaning visually</td>

                    <div class="prose max-w-none prose-headings:tracking-tight prose-headings:text-aeblack-800 prose-a:text-primary-700 prose-h1:text-h3 lg:prose-h1:text-h2 xl:prose-h1:text-h1 prose-h2:text-h4 lg:prose-h2:text-h3 xl:prose-h2:text-h2 prose-h3:text-h5 lg:prose-h3:text-h4 xl:prose-h3:text-h3 prose-h4:text-h6 lg:prose-h4:text-h5 xl:prose-h4:text-h4 prose-h5:text-lg lg:prose-h5:text-h6 xl:prose-h5:text-h5 prose-h6:text-base lg:prose-h6:text-lg xl:prose-h6:text-h6">
    <p>The following notes are applicable of this component.</p>
<h3 id="built-in-accessibility">Built-in accessibility</h3>
<ul>
<li>The dismiss button is a real <code><button type="button"></code>, so it is focusable, keyboard-activatable, and exposed correctly to assistive technologies by default.</li>
<li>The dismiss button's <code>aria-label</code> is context-aware — it automatically includes the badge's text content, so screen readers announce <em>"Dismiss Approved"</em>, <em>"Dismiss Error"</em>, etc. rather than a generic label. The text is read once, when the badge first loads — if the label changes afterwards, the dismiss label keeps the original text, so re-create the badge rather than editing its text in place. When the badge has no text it falls back to <em>"Dismiss badge"</em> (<em>"إغلاق الشارة"</em> in RTL).</li>
<li>The dismiss button maintains a minimum touch target of <strong>24 × 24 CSS px</strong> on every badge size (sm, base, lg), satisfying WCAG SC 2.5.8.</li>
<li>The dismiss SVG icon is <code>aria-hidden="true"</code> — all meaning is carried by the button's <code>aria-label</code>.</li>
<li>The dismiss-click handler calls <code>event.stopPropagation()</code>, so a parent click handler does not also fire when a badge is dismissed.</li>
<li><code>aria-*</code> and <code>data-*</code> attributes set on the host are forwarded to the inner <code><span></code>.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="developer-responsibility">Developer responsibility</h3>
<p>The following is required for a developer to add additionally or pay attention to regarding this component.</p>
<ul>
<li>Provide meaningful text inside the badge. Colour alone is not sufficient to convey status — pair colour with explicit words such as "Active", "Pending", or "Suspended".</li>
<li>For badges acting as numerical counters, give the count its context in text, for example <code><aegov-badge>3 <span class="sr-only">unread messages</span></aegov-badge></code>. An <code>aria-label</code> on the host is copied to a role-less <code><span></code>, and screen readers do not reliably announce names on elements without a role.</li>
<li>After a dismiss, remove the badge and move focus to a sensible element (the next badge, or the filter group) — the focused dismiss button disappears with it.</li>
<li>If a badge's value changes over time, consider wrapping it (or its surrounding container) in an <code>aria-live="polite"</code> region so assistive technology announces the update.</li>
<li>Removing the badge from the DOM after dismiss is the consumer's responsibility — the component emits <code>aegovBadgeDismiss</code> but does not auto-remove itself.</li>
<li>Mark decorative inline icons with <code>aria-hidden="true"</code>. The badge text is the sole accessible label.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="additional-notes">Additional notes</h3>
<ul>
<li>Icons placed inside the slot inherit sizing automatically based on the <code>size</code> prop — you do not need to set width/height on the icon.</li>
<li><code>Tab</code> moves focus to the dismiss button when present; <code>Enter</code> or <code>Space</code> activates it. A non-dismissible badge is not focusable and is not part of the tab order.</li>
</ul>

    <h2 id="anatomy">Anatomy</h2>
<p>The <code>aegov-banner</code> component renders a full-width bar pinned to the top or bottom of the viewport, with a variant icon, message content, optional action buttons, and an optional dismiss control.</p>
<p><img src="https://designsystem.gov.ae/storage/documentation/banner/banner-anatomoy-img-001.png" alt="Image showing anatomy of a banner"></p>

    <h2 id="position-display-strategy-and-mode">Position, display strategy, and mode</h2>
<p><code>position</code> (<code>top</code> | <code>bottom</code>) chooses which viewport edge the banner pins to. <code>display</code> chooses the CSS mechanism — <code>fixed</code> (default) stays glued to that edge regardless of scroll, <code>sticky</code> scrolls with the page until it reaches the edge, then sticks. <code>mode</code> chooses the layout strategy — <code>push</code> (default, only with <code>display="fixed"</code>) adds matching padding to <code><body></code> so page content is never covered; <code>overlay</code> floats above content instead and emits <code>aegovBannerHeightChange</code> so you can react to its height yourself.</p>
<p>These three properties genuinely pin an element to the real page viewport and mutate <code><body></code>'s padding, so — matching the reference project's own documentation approach — this page does not attempt to live-preview them in isolation; every other live example on this page already demonstrates the safe <code>display="sticky" mode="overlay"</code> combination in a contained box. Use the code below directly in your own page to see real <code>fixed</code>/<code>push</code> behaviour.</p>

    <h2 id="critical-alerts-and-heading-association">Critical alerts and heading association</h2>
<p>Set <code>is-focusable="true"</code> for alerts that demand immediate attention — the banner focuses itself on mount. This only takes effect when the resolved role is <code>alert</code>, which <code>variant="error"</code> produces (or a <code>role="alert"</code> set on the host); it has no effect on <code>success</code>, <code>info</code>, <code>warning</code>, or <code>default</code> banners. Use it sparingly, since it interrupts the user's current keyboard focus.</p>
<p>There is no <code>heading</code> prop. To label the banner for assistive technology, set <code>aria-labelledby</code> on the host pointing at the <code>id</code> of a heading you render yourself inside the default slot — the attribute is copied to the inner banner element. <code>field-id</code> sets that inner element's own <code>id</code>.</p>
<p>This page does not auto-focus either example live, since stealing keyboard focus unexpectedly while reading documentation would itself be disruptive — the behaviour is exactly as described above when used on a real page.</p>

                    <div class="prose max-w-none prose-headings:tracking-tight prose-headings:text-aeblack-800 prose-a:text-primary-700 prose-h1:text-h3 lg:prose-h1:text-h2 xl:prose-h1:text-h1 prose-h2:text-h4 lg:prose-h2:text-h3 xl:prose-h2:text-h2 prose-h3:text-h5 lg:prose-h3:text-h4 xl:prose-h3:text-h3 prose-h4:text-h6 lg:prose-h4:text-h5 xl:prose-h4:text-h4 prose-h5:text-lg lg:prose-h5:text-h6 xl:prose-h5:text-h5 prose-h6:text-base lg:prose-h6:text-lg xl:prose-h6:text-h6">
    <p>The following notes are applicable of this component.</p>
<h3 id="built-in-accessibility">Built-in accessibility</h3>
<ul>
<li>The role auto-computes from <code>variant</code> — only <code>error</code> resolves to <code>role="alert"</code> (assertive, interrupts immediately); <code>success</code>, <code>info</code>, <code>warning</code>, and <code>default</code> all resolve to <code>role="status"</code> (polite, announced when the screen reader is idle).</li>
<li>Neither role sets an explicit <code>aria-live</code> attribute — both <code>alert</code> and <code>status</code> carry their <code>aria-live</code> value implicitly per the WAI-ARIA specification, which is the behaviour recommended by the <a href="https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/alert/examples/alert/">APG Alert pattern</a>.</li>
<li>A built-in variant icon renders automatically alongside the text, so severity is conveyed by shape as well as colour (WCAG SC 1.4.1). The icon column is <code>aria-hidden="true"</code> — the slotted text is the sole accessible announcement.</li>
<li>The dismiss button has <code>aria-label="Close banner"</code> (<code>"إغلاق الشريط"</code> under <code>dir="rtl"</code>) and its icon is <code>aria-hidden="true"</code>.</li>
<li>In <code>display="fixed" mode="push"</code>, body padding is set and cleared automatically via a <code>ResizeObserver</code> so page content is never hidden underneath, and is also cleared on dismiss and on disconnect.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="developer-responsibility">Developer responsibility</h3>
<p>The following is required for a developer to add additionally or pay attention to regarding this component.</p>
<ul>
<li>Choose <code>variant</code> thoughtfully — <code>role="alert"</code> interrupts screen reader users immediately. Reserve <code>error</code> for messages that genuinely require immediate attention.</li>
<li>There is no <code>heading</code> prop. Setting <code>aria-labelledby</code> on the host only creates the ARIA relationship — you must still render the heading element yourself inside the default slot with a matching <code>id</code>.</li>
<li>Use <code>is-focusable="true"</code> sparingly — it steals keyboard focus on mount, which is disruptive outside genuinely critical alerts, and only ever takes effect when the resolved role is <code>alert</code>.</li>
<li>Use only one <code>display="fixed" mode="push"</code> banner per edge — each one writes <code><body></code>'s inline <code>padding-top</code> or <code>padding-bottom</code> and overwrites any other inline value there.</li>
<li>A dismissed banner cannot be reopened: the host stays in the DOM, empty. Remove it and create a new element to show it again.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="additional-notes">Additional notes</h3>
<ul>
<li>The <code>size</code> property is responsive-string capable (<code>size="sm md:base xl:lg"</code>), matching the same mechanism used by Badge and Accordion.</li>
<li><code>mode="overlay"</code> is intended for layouts that reserve their own space for the banner — subscribe to <code>aegovBannerHeightChange</code> and apply the height to your own layout (a CSS custom property, for example) rather than relying on automatic body padding, which only applies in <code>mode="push"</code>.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="keyboard-support">Keyboard support</h3>
<div class="my-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-aeblack-950/10" data-table-wrap=""><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Key</th>
<th>Action</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>Tab</code></td>
<td>Move focus into the banner (any controls in the <code>actions</code> slot, then the dismiss button).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>Enter</code>, <code>Space</code></td>
<td>Activate the focused control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>Shift + Tab</code></td>
<td>Move focus backwards.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div>

                <h1 class="text-h3 lg:text-h2 xl:text-h1 mb-4 text-primary-700">Bento Grid</h1>
                <p class="text-base lg:text-lg leading-normal text-aeblack-600">A Bento Grid arranges aegov-card elements into a balanced-but-non-uniform "bento box" layout. It owns the column count, the gap between tiles, and the responsive stacking behaviour, while each card declares its own column and row span via simple data attributes.</p>

    <h2 id="auto-flow-dense-vs-row">Auto-flow — dense vs. row</h2>
<p>The <code>flow</code> property controls how the browser places tiles when spans leave gaps. <code>dense</code> (default) back-fills earlier holes with later, smaller tiles — the classic bento packing. <code>row</code> keeps strict DOM order — a tile that doesn't fit the current row pushes to the next, leaving the gap behind it. In this 3-column example, A and B both span 2 columns, so B cannot fit next to A on row one and moves to row two — leaving a 1-column gap in row one. <code>dense</code> fills that gap with C (the next tile that fits); <code>row</code> leaves the gap empty and places C strictly after B instead.</p>

                    <div class="prose max-w-none prose-headings:tracking-tight prose-headings:text-aeblack-800 prose-a:text-primary-700 prose-h1:text-h3 lg:prose-h1:text-h2 xl:prose-h1:text-h1 prose-h2:text-h4 lg:prose-h2:text-h3 xl:prose-h2:text-h2 prose-h3:text-h5 lg:prose-h3:text-h4 xl:prose-h3:text-h3 prose-h4:text-h6 lg:prose-h4:text-h5 xl:prose-h4:text-h4 prose-h5:text-lg lg:prose-h5:text-h6 xl:prose-h5:text-h5 prose-h6:text-base lg:prose-h6:text-lg xl:prose-h6:text-h6">
    <p>The following notes are applicable of this component.</p>
<h3 id="built-in-accessibility">Built-in accessibility</h3>
<ul>
<li>The inner wrapper has <code>role="group"</code>, so assistive technologies announce the cluster as a single unit.</li>
<li>Tab order follows DOM order regardless of visual placement. Cards remain individually focusable and behave exactly as they would outside a grid.</li>
<li>The grid itself introduces no interactive semantics — there is no keyboard handling layered on top of the cards it contains.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="developer-responsibility">Developer responsibility</h3>
<p>The following is required for a developer to add additionally or pay attention to regarding this component.</p>
<ul>
<li>Add <code>aria-label</code> (or <code>aria-labelledby</code>) on the host when the cluster has a meaningful name — the default <code>role="group"</code> alone is generic.</li>
<li>If a tile is meant to be clickable, make sure it is itself a focusable element (a link or button inside the card) — the bento grid does not wrap children in an interactive element.</li>
<li>Do not rely on visual ordering alone to communicate priority. Screen readers follow DOM order regardless of how <code>flow="dense"</code> re-shuffles the visual layout.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="additional-notes">Additional notes</h3>
<ul>
<li>Per-card spans are applied as inline styles (<code>grid-column</code>, <code>grid-row</code>) directly on each direct child, and cleared entirely once resolved span is <code>1</code>.</li>
<li>A <code>MutationObserver</code> watches <code>data-col-span</code>/<code>data-row-span</code> on direct children, so updating a span from JavaScript re-applies the layout automatically — no manual re-render call needed.</li>
<li>Only direct children receive layout treatment. A nested <code>aegov-card</code> inside a tile is unaffected by the grid's span logic.</li>
</ul>

    <h2 id="anatomy">Anatomy</h2>
<p>The <code>aegov-blockquote</code> component renders a single native <code><blockquote></code> element. The <code>primary</code> (default) appearance shows a decorative quotation-mark icon; the <code>colored</code> appearance replaces it with a tinted background and a colored start-edge border instead. An optional footer holds the <code>author</code> and <code>authorTitle</code>, shown only when at least one is set.</p>
<p><img src="https://designsystem.gov.ae/storage/documentation/blockquote/blockquote-anatomoy-img-001.png" alt="Image showing anatomy of a blockquote"></p>

                    <div class="prose max-w-none prose-headings:tracking-tight prose-headings:text-aeblack-800 prose-a:text-primary-700 prose-h1:text-h3 lg:prose-h1:text-h2 xl:prose-h1:text-h1 prose-h2:text-h4 lg:prose-h2:text-h3 xl:prose-h2:text-h2 prose-h3:text-h5 lg:prose-h3:text-h4 xl:prose-h3:text-h3 prose-h4:text-h6 lg:prose-h4:text-h5 xl:prose-h4:text-h4 prose-h5:text-lg lg:prose-h5:text-h6 xl:prose-h5:text-h5 prose-h6:text-base lg:prose-h6:text-lg xl:prose-h6:text-h6">
    <p>The following notes are applicable of this component.</p>
<h3 id="built-in-accessibility">Built-in accessibility</h3>
<ul>
<li>The rendered element is a real <code><blockquote></code>, so the quotation is conveyed structurally, not only visually — screen readers can announce the boundaries of quoted content.</li>
<li><code>cite</code> maps to the native <code>cite</code> attribute, keeping the source machine-readable. It is <strong>not visible</strong> to sighted users; browsers do not render it.</li>
<li>The decorative quotation-mark icon is <code>aria-hidden="true"</code>, so it is never announced as content — its visual orientation (see the note under RTL support) has no bearing on accessibility either way.</li>
<li>Attribution (<code>author</code>/<code>authorTitle</code>) renders inside the quote block in a fixed position, so it is never separated from the quotation it belongs to.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="developer-responsibility">Developer responsibility</h3>
<p>The following is required for a developer to add additionally or pay attention to regarding this component.</p>
<ul>
<li>Attribute your quotes where practical. Set <code>author</code> (and <code>authorTitle</code> where the role adds weight) — an unattributed quotation reads as an unsourced claim, especially in a government context.</li>
<li><code>cite</code> is invisible to sighted users. Add a visible link after the quote as well if the reader should be able to reach the source.</li>
<li>Keep quotations to a comfortable reading width, roughly 60–100 characters per line — a full-width pull quote is harder to read than the body copy around it. Put a width class on the host (for example <code>class="max-w-3xl"</code>) if the surrounding layout does not already constrain it — <code>extra-class</code> only accepts spacing utilities, so width classes there have no effect.</li>
<li>Do not use a blockquote purely for visual emphasis. It is semantic markup for quoted material — to highlight your own text use a Callout, and to make text larger without implying a quotation use Text with a size token.</li>
<li>Mark a quote that is in a different language from the rest of the page with <code>lang</code> and <code>dir</code> on the host, so assistive technology switches pronunciation correctly (WCAG 2.2 SC 3.1.2).</li>
<li>Check contrast when using <code>appearance="colored"</code> — the tinted background sits behind the text, and the 4.5:1 minimum of WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 still applies.</li>
<li>Restore contrast in dark mode yourself. Colours inside the shadow root are fixed light-mode colours and do not follow a page-level <code>.dark</code> class; override them with <code>::part(blockquote)</code> and style slotted <code><p></code> elements directly. The author and title lines cannot be restyled.</li>
<li>Avoid putting interactive content inside the quote. A link within quoted text is fine; a button is not — it turns quoted content into a control surface.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="additional-notes">Additional notes</h3>
<ul>
<li>Quote accuracy (using an ellipsis for omissions, etc.) is an editorial responsibility, not something the component enforces.</li>
</ul>

    <h2 id="anatomy">Anatomy</h2>
<p>The <code>aegov-button</code> component composes a single native <code><button></code> element with full keyboard, focus, and screen-reader support. Its visual style is driven by three orthogonal properties: <strong>variant</strong> (the colour family — primary, secondary, danger, neutral), <strong>appearance</strong> (the visual treatment — solid, outline, soft, link), and <strong>size</strong> (xs through xl).</p>
<p>Additional state properties handle loading, disabled, full-width, icon-only, and group positioning.</p>

<h3 id="disabled">Disabled</h3>
<p>Communicates that a button exists, but isn’t available in that scenario. When the user hovers over a button in a disabled state, the cursor shows as <strong>"not allowed"</strong>.</p>
<p>A disabled button leaves the Tab order. Add <code>is-disabled-focusable</code> to keep it focusable (with <code>aria-disabled="true"</code>) so keyboard and screen-reader users can still reach it and any explanation of why it is unavailable.</p>
<p>Disabled buttons maintain layout consistency and communicate that a button may become available if another condition is met.</p>

    <h2 id="button-group">Button group</h2>
<p>The <code>aegov-button-group</code> component visually joins two or more <code>aegov-button</code> children edge-to-edge by collapsing internal borders and adjusting corner radii.</p>
<p>It supports horizontal (default) and vertical orientations, and works with every variant, appearance, and size.</p>
<p>The group automatically writes a <code>groupPosition</code> (first / middle / last / single) and <code>groupOrientation</code> (horizontal / vertical) onto each direct child button so the correct border and radius styles are applied.</p>

<p>Combine <code>is-icon</code> with a button group to create a compact toolbar. Always provide an <code>aria-label</code> on each icon-only button so screen readers can announce its purpose, and an <code>aria-label</code> on the group to describe the toolbar.</p>

                    <div class="prose max-w-none prose-headings:tracking-tight prose-headings:text-aeblack-800 prose-a:text-primary-700 prose-h1:text-h3 lg:prose-h1:text-h2 xl:prose-h1:text-h1 prose-h2:text-h4 lg:prose-h2:text-h3 xl:prose-h2:text-h2 prose-h3:text-h5 lg:prose-h3:text-h4 xl:prose-h3:text-h3 prose-h4:text-h6 lg:prose-h4:text-h5 xl:prose-h4:text-h4 prose-h5:text-lg lg:prose-h5:text-h6 xl:prose-h5:text-h5 prose-h6:text-base lg:prose-h6:text-lg xl:prose-h6:text-h6">
    <p>The following notes are applicable of this component.</p>
<h3 id="built-in-accessibility">Built-in accessibility</h3>
<ul>
<li>The <code>aegov-button</code> renders a <code><button></code>  element. So it is focusable, keyboard-activatable, and exposed correctly to assistive technologies by default.</li>
<li><code>is-disabled</code> sets the native <code>disabled</code> attribute, so the button leaves the Tab order. With <code>is-disabled-focusable</code> it gets <code>aria-disabled="true"</code> instead and stays focusable, while activation is still blocked.</li>
<li>Loading does not use native <code>disabled</code>: that would drop focus to the page mid-submit. A loading button keeps focus, is marked <code>aria-disabled="true"</code> and <code>aria-busy="true"</code>, and ignores activation until loading ends.</li>
<li>The loading spinner SVG is <code>aria-hidden="true"</code>. A visually hidden <code>aria-live="polite"</code> status region outside the button announces "Loading" (in Arabic on Arabic pages), so the word never becomes part of the button's name.</li>
<li>An icon-only button (<code>is-icon</code>) without <code>aria-label</code>, <code>aria-labelledby</code> or <code>title</code> logs a console warning. Once it is named, slotted <code><svg></code> icons are marked <code>aria-hidden="true"</code> automatically.</li>
<li><code>focus-visible</code> outline is tuned per appearance.</li>
<li><code>aegov-button-group</code> wraps its buttons in <code><div role="group"></code> and forwards all <code>aria-*</code> and <code>data-*</code> attributes from the host to that div.</li>
<li><code>aria-*</code> and <code>data-*</code> attributes set on the host are forwarded to the inner <code><button></code>.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="developer-responsibility">Developer responsibility</h3>
<p>The following is required for a developer to add additionally or pay attention to regarding this component.</p>
<ul>
<li>Provide an <code>aria-label</code> on every icon-only button.  Slot content alone is not enough for accessibility.</li>
<li>Do not add <code>aria-label</code> to a button that has visible text. The visible text is already its name, and a different <code>aria-label</code> breaks voice control (a user saying "click Login" can't reach a button named "archive"). If you must add one, it has to start with the visible text.</li>
<li>For loading buttons whose visible label does not change, ensure to update the slot content. Example: A button label is <em>"Save"</em>, but while the loading state, you must change it to <em>"Saving ..."</em>. Ensure to also update <code>aria-label</code> content.</li>
<li>Do not wrap <code>aegov-button</code> inside another <code><button></code>. Nesting interactive elements is invalid HTML</li>
<li>The link appearance still renders a <code><button></code>. This must not be used for navigation. Refer to the component called <code>aegov-link</code> for that.</li>
<li>Inside a button group, every direct child must be an <code>aegov-button</code> (a wrapping <code><div></code> is also allowed, for layout). Any other element produces a console warning.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="additional-notes">Additional notes</h3>
<ul>
<li>The loading state already blocks activation, so you do not also need to set <code>is-disabled</code> — and setting it would take the button out of the Tab order and drop focus.</li>
<li>The host element itself is not focusable. To move focus to the button from script, call its <code>setFocus()</code> method rather than <code>focus()</code>.</li>
<li><code>type="submit"</code> submits the surrounding form like a native submit button: the form is validated, and <code>event.submitter</code> in the <code>submit</code> handler is a hidden native <code><button></code> standing in for the <code>aegov-button</code>, carrying its <code>name</code> and <code>value</code> — so <code>new FormData(form, event.submitter)</code> and a native form post both include the pair. <code>formaction</code>, <code>formenctype</code>, <code>formmethod</code>, <code>formnovalidate</code> and <code>formtarget</code> set on <code>aegov-button</code> override the form's own settings for that submission.</li>
<li><code>type="reset"</code> resets the surrounding form, even when one of its controls is named or has the id <code>reset</code>.</li>
<li>Icons placed inside the slot inherit the current text size automatically.</li>
<li>Nesting an <code>aegov-button-group</code> inside another <code>aegov-button-group</code> produces invalid structure and is not supported.</li>
<li>For consistent visuals inside a group, use the same <code>size</code>, <code>variant</code> and <code>appearance</code> on every child button. Mixed attributes are technically allowed but produce uneven results.</li>
</ul>

</div>
